title: This Free 15 MB App Lets Codex Run on DeepSeek
description:
Codex talks to OpenAI. Claude Code talks to Anthropic. magpie, a free and open-source (MIT) app, lets any coding agent use any model: it runs a gateway on your own computer that translates between OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini formats, streaming and tool calls included.

Full breakdown: https://youtu.be/TuOnUlJSWho
